intro: Deputy Feldon is a member of the Redridge town guard stationed just south of the Great Lakeshire Bridge. Tasked with watching the primary road into Lakeshire, he keeps a nervous vigil against the aggressive gnoll packs creeping toward the town perimeter.

p: Standing watch near the southern approach to the Lakeshire bridge, Deputy Feldon represents an overextended town guard fighting to keep basic trade and travel routes open. With the Blackrock orcs pressing from the north and gnoll packs overrunning the southern hills, guardsmen like Feldon are stretched to their limits. Unable to leave his post without compromising the town's perimeter, he relies on passing adventurers to cull the gnolls encroaching on the roadway before they can cut Lakeshire off entirely.
